mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces earnings expectations and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when RSAFS falls > 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the industrial production index above 0.4% signals improving manufacturing output and economic growth, which boosts earnings expectations and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when INDPRO rises > 0.4% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the federal funds rate above 0.25 percentage points signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in nonfarm payrolls above 50,000 signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when PAYEMS rises > 50,000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the housing starts index above 5,000 units signals improving residential investment and consumer confidence, which supports corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when HOUST rises > 5,000 units (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points combined with a monthly decline in nonfarm payrolls above 50,000 signals a significant deterioration in labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp AND PAYEMS falls > 50,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when both UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and PAYEMS falls > 50,000 (t-test p > 0.05).
